text:
Ajay: planning to flip feature toggle `new-routing-v2` to 10% tonight at 23:00 UTC. who can own the deploy + smoke?
Maria: I can be on deploy and watch until 00:30 UTC. will handle the rollback if needed.
Sam: I can run the smoke checklist and monitor traces. post the runbook link and the exact deploy steps here.
Ajay: steps: 1) set flag via feature-flag-api UI (percent=10). 2) confirm canary traffic routes to pool-b. 3) run quick smoke (see below). 4) watch error rate + latency for 15m.
Priya: rollback ready. rollback is `feature-flag-api set new-routing-v2 --percent 0` or `kubectl patch cm routing-config -p '{"data":{"new-routing-v2":"off"}}'` if we need a config-level kill.
Leo: confirm safe default is OFF for tenants not in the 10%. double-check /health responses and prefix-cache keys. also enable circuit-breaker safe-defaults for routev2 during the window.
Sam: smoke commands (quick):
```
# curl health and a small inference path
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood-inference.internal/health
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":2}' | jq -c .
# tail logs for errors
kubectl --context prod logs -l app=inference -n inference --tail=200 | egrep "ERROR|panic" || true
```
Maria: i'll open a brief monitoring window in Grafana: dashboard `routing-v2-canary` and add 15m alert for errors > 0.5% or 95th latency > 200ms.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled by Ajay for 23:00 UTC. ETA: 5m to flip.
Ajay: i'll flip at 23:00 and post a status update when the percent is live. if anything abnormal, rollback to 0% immediately and ping #eng-oncall.
Priya: noted. my rollback steps and pager policy are ready. ping me if error-rate spikes or customers report routing issues.
Leo: quick preflight: I verified the feature flag default is `off` for new tenants and the rollout list contains only the intended segments.
Sam: +1. i'll do the smoke run at T+2m after flip and paste results here.
Ajay: thanks all — see you in thread. :thumbsup:
